{{Quote|You've served your master well.''"<br />"''Indeed.|A spacer and 6-POC|<ref name="SWG:ABLTG" />}}
'''6-POC''' was a [[LOM-series protocol droid/Legends|LOM-series protocol droid]] who served for a project manager of [[GeneTech Syndicate]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], 6-POC operated out of the [[GeneTech Syndicate Lab]] near the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]] on the [[Double Worlds|Double World]] of [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. After a containment breach of violent [[Bioengineering/Legends|genetically engineered]] [[arachne]] creatures wiped out [[Gender/Legends|his]] master and the other lab [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]], 6-POC reluctantly divulged a secret password to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] so that they could delete sensitive information regarding the dangerous [[Parasophic Arachne]] project.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Your Master is dead. The experiment is a failure.''"<br />"''That cannot be! Before these creatures came he was just fine.''"<br />"''These creatures killed him.|A spacer and 6-POC|<ref name="SWG:ABLTG" />}}
A [[LOM-series protocol droid/Legends|LOM-series protocol droid]] by the name of 6-POC operated for [[GeneTech Syndicate]] out of the [[GeneTech Syndicate Lab]] located outside of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]] on the [[Double Worlds|Double World]] of [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:ABLTG" /> Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the GeneTech Syndicate conducted an highly illegal and dangerous [[Bioengineering/Legends|bioengineering]] project in the GeneTech Syndicate Lab dubbed [[Parasophic Arachne]] program. The objective was to create an intelligent and powerful form of [[arachne]]s for the use of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SWG:G">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Genocide|Talus}}</ref>
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars Galaxies}}
[[File:GeneTech_Syndicate_Lab.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The [[GeneTech Syndicate Lab]].]]
Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Taarna]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]] dispatched a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to investigate the GeneTech Lab near Dearic. During the course of the investigation, it became apparent to Taarna that illicit genetic testing on [[Species/Legends|animals]] was taking place. This included the hatching of numerous, monstrously large arachne creatures that breached containment and overran the entire facility. Deeming the lab a threat to the entire [[Planet/Legends|world]] of Talus, Taarna ordered the spacer to carry out a number of objectives in an effort to sabotage it.<ref name="SWG:G" /> One of these objectives included the deletion of all information about the Parasophic Arachne project from multiple [[Computer/Legends|computer]] terminals. However, a very sophisticated encryption system prevented the spacer from successfully [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]] into one of the terminals belonging to the laboratory's project manager.<ref name="SWG:ABLTG" />

As it turned out however, the project manager's [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], 6-POC, knew the password. However, 6-POC was at first reluctant to divulge it. It was not until the spacer explained to 6-POC that his master was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the ferocious beasts, that 6-POC began to consider otherwise. Fearing loneliness in a world eradicated by the beasts of the GeneTech Lab, 6-POC finally revealed to the spacer that the entry code to his master's terminal was "[[Zerek/Legends|zerek]] species." The spacer commended the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] for serving his master well, and then proceeded to delete the sensitive information off the project manager's computer, in addition to five other terminals spread throughout the facility.<ref name="SWG:ABLTG" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|They are going to kill everyone on Talus if you do not help me!''"<br />"''Everyone?''"<br />"''Yes, you will be alone.''"<br />"''I&hellip;I do not want that. I don't believe that was master's intent.|A spacer and 6-POC|<ref name="SWG:ABLTG" />}}
6-POC had [[Silver/Legends|silver]] [[Color/Legends|colored]] plating and black and silver [[Eye/Legends|eye]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. Loyal and dedicated,<ref name="SWG:ABLTG" /> the droid belonged to a product line produced by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] equipped with [[AA-1 VerboBrain/Legends|AA-1 VerboBrains]].<ref name="RECG" /> Ever hesitant to divulge his master's private terminal password, 6-POC nevertheless relented when it became apparent that his master was dead, and that the entire population of Talus could be eradicated by violent beasts. Capable of independent thought, and fears of loneliness, 6-POC understood that giving the spacer his password was what his master would have wanted.<ref name="SWG:ABLTG" />

==Behind the scenes==
6-POC was a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ABLTG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> He was added to the game as part of the expansive [[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]] series with the release of "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 2|Chapter 2: The Talus Incident]]" on [[August 1]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 2: The Talus Incident Publish Notes, August 1st">{{SonyForumsCite|full_url=http://soe.lithium.com/swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=58871|text="Chapter 2: The Talus Incident" Publish Notes, August 1st}}</ref> In the game, players who accepted the "[[W:c:swg:Genocide|Genocide]]" quest from [[W:c:swg:CorSec agent Taarna|CorSec agent Taarna]] were tasked with investigating the [[W:c:swg:GeneTech Syndicate Labs|GeneTech Syndicate Lab]] on Talus.<ref name="SWG:G" /> One of the sub-quests titled a "[[W:c:swg:A Better Life Through Genetics|A Better Life Through Genetics]]," required players to delete information off of six terminals, one of which required the player to converse with 6-POC to obtain a password. Although the player could choose not to do these quests, this article assumes 100% game completion.<ref name="SWG:ABLTG" />
